verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a DevSecOps platform with SaaS and self-managed editions, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry, usage-tracking, or analytics opt-out. The Agent Platform on/off toggle (gitlab-docs-49, gitlab-docs-63) enables or disables a feature, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit here.
